genre_archetype: refracted hook mining with order-based cave collection
camera_perspective: fixed 2D side cutaway crystal cavern with top winch and layered target field
control_model: tap to launch the swinging claw, tap tool buttons for dynamite, magnet pulse, cable boost, prism lens, and shield glove
core_loop_signature: read the swing arc and cave layout, launch hook, bend or boost through prism tools, catch weighted treasure or order targets, pull items back, avoid shard hazards, complete stage orders, earn coins, and upgrade mining tools
differentiation_axes: prism crystals can bend or preview the hook path instead of a single straight claw line
stage orders require specific target families rather than only a money quota
hazard shards, bombs, and bats create risk during hook timing and return
tool choices change the outcome of bad pulls or heavy targets
layered cave bands create shallow, mid, and deep target planning
forbidden_template_reuse: do not copy a classic hook miner loop as aim hook pull loot only
do not use farm, ranch, market, or animal management loops
do not use tower defense lane waves or rail defense routes
do not represent every collectible as plain circles with only score labels
do not cover the central swing arc with HUD panels or decorative frames

map_content_budget.play_area_model: fixed cavern board with top winch, central hook field, layered target bands, side tool pocket, and bottom order rail
map_content_budget.camera_or_scroll_model: fixed screen with stage-to-stage layout variation and no scrolling during a pull

primary_player_actions: judge item weight and return speed
secondary_player_actions: prioritize shallow fast targets or deep heavy treasure
special_rules: fragile crystals can break if hit by bombs or shard traps
prism crystals bend hook path once per launch
wrong catches consume time but may still sell for coins
stage orders can require specific item families or no-shatter completion
risk_reward_systems: deep treasures are valuable but slow enough to risk the timer
bombs can clear hazards but punish accidental direct pulls
prism bends can reach rare gems but require more precise timing
tool charges can save a bad pull but reduce later flexibility
failure_pressure_variants: high-value target gets blocked by hazard placement

primary_game_art_packs: license-clear cave, crystal, treasure, and mining hook assets or project-local generated canvas art with tracked roles
asset_variety_budget.ui_pack: skin_cartoon_light with custom crystal cave panels and brass tool buttons
asset_variety_budget.animation_tier: delivery-ready hook swing, launch, catch, return, sparkle, shatter, and bat flap states
asset_variety_budget.asset_reuse_note: Existing generic hook or gold assets may only be reused if prism crystals, order chips, cave hazards, and crystal identity are visually distinct from a classic hook miner baseline.
